report_slide_1_title: Every report contributes to the lab.
report_slide_1_body: I design and maintain this portfolio on my own. When you point out a bug, it helps me spot blind spots and raise the standard of my work.
report_slide_2_body: Report functional and security bugs such as broken links, copy mistakes, pages that fail to load, or elements overlapping on your device.
report_slide_3_title: Tests and reports out of scope
report_slide_3_body: Automated scanners, attempts to access others' data, denial-of-service tests, and attacks on servers are not accepted. Only functional and security issues will be processed.
report_reason_content: 01 · Content – Broken link or copy mistake
report_reason_a11y: 03 · Accessibility – Something you can't reach, read or use
report_reason_security: 05 · Security – Spoofed content or text injection
report_err_page: Tell me where you saw it.
report_msg_placeholder: Describe what you were doing, what you expected to see, and what happened on your screen.
report_disclaimer: I read every report and will follow up if I need more context.
report_success_body: Thank you for helping the lab grow.
